mentions.name: Bonsai
mentions.description: A 3D voxel-based game engine developed for about 10 years in spare time, getting close to being 'shadertoy for voxels'. Its terrain generators were recently ported to the GPU, increasing the visible volume to 1 billion voxels cubed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a 3D voxel-based game engine for like 10 years in my spare time.  At this point it's getting pretty close to being shadertoy for voxels.
